title: Leakage-Aware Fault Detection on GPVS-Faults (code and results)
description: Evaluation of fault classification and detection on the public GPVS-Faults grid-connected PV inverter dataset. A random forest separates runs at macro-F1 1.000 using only windows recorded before the estimated fault onset, so random window splits let models recognize the recording rather than the fault. Subtracting each run's fault-free baseline helps across operating modes (MPPT/IPPT) but does not remove this shortcut: the same test still scores 0.897 (MPPT) and 0.961 (IPPT). Version 1.1.0 adds a 1D CNN, held-out detection thresholds and robustness checks, and reproduces these figures.
